fixes.what: Remove `.journey__note{display:none}` inside `@media (min-width:768px)` and adjust the desktop `.journey__stops` grid (e.g., to a 3x3 layout or increased gap) so the notes remain visible.
fixes.why: Hiding the journey notes on desktop strips away your best trust-building lines for parents ('First meeting with parents and grandparents. Elders first.', 'Ritual by ritual, in both languages').

fixes.what:
Add a venue/location text field to the inquiry form: `
` alongside `Guest count`.
fixes.why: In the Bay Area, knowing whether a 250-guest multi-day cultural production is in SF, Napa, or the South Bay is critical for qualifying the inquiry and preparing for the first family consultation.

fixes.what: Change the `wedding_date` input from `type="date"` to `type="text"` with `placeholder="e.g. Fall 2026 or Oct 10–12, 2026"` and label `Wedding date or season`.
fixes.why: Multi-day Persian, Afghan, and South Asian weddings span 2 to 4 days and families often inquire with a target season before booking a venue; a strict single-date picker creates unnecessary friction.

fixes.what: Add `<label class="check"><input type="checkbox" name="traditions" value="Shirini-khori / engagement"> Shirini-khori / engagement</label>` or an `Other / blended` option to the Traditions fieldset.
fixes.why: Afghan and Persian families frequently include Shirini-khori (or South Asian families include Haldi/Dholki/Roka), and interfaith/blended couples need an obvious way to signal their traditions.

fixes.what: Update the Persian label in the Mehndi & Sangeet accordion panel from `حنابندان` to `حنابندان · سنگیت` (and match in `weddings.html:134`).
fixes.why: Pairing the Persian/Afghan term for Henna night alongside Sangeet in the script shows equal fluency and respect for South Asian families reading the headings.

fixes.what: Add a direct WhatsApp link next to the phone and email in `.form__note`: `Or call (925) 263-9949 · WhatsApp · hello@anarevents.com`.
fixes.why: Persian, Afghan, and South Asian parents and couples overwhelmingly prefer WhatsApp for initial outreach; having it right beneath the form submit button (not just in the footer) captures hesitant leads.
